question: At a certain point in a plane electromagnetic wave travelling in vacuum along the positive $x$-direction, the electric field is $\vec{E} = 8.4\hat{k}\text{ V m}^{-1}$. Determine the magnitude and direction of the magnetic field at that point. Justify your answer using the directional relation among $\vec{E}$, $\vec{B}$ and the propagation direction.

options.B:
$B=\dfrac{E}{c}=\dfrac{8.4}{3.0\times10^8}=2.8\times10^{-8}\text{ T}$.
Since propagation is along $+\hat{i}$ and $\vec E$ is along $+\hat{k}$, $\vec E\times\vec B$ must be along $+\hat{i}$; hence $\vec B$ is along $-\hat{j}$.
Thus $\vec{B}=-2.8\times10^{-8}\hat{j}\text{ T}$.
options.C: $\vec{B}=+2.8\times10^{-8}\hat{k}\text{ T}$, because the magnetic field is parallel to the electric field in an electromagnetic wave.
options.D: $\vec{B}=-8.4\times10^{-8}\hat{j}\text{ T}$, because the magnetic field has the same magnitude as the electric field.
